Services.Name: Windows
Services.Description: The windows of the page (the Window component): their order and the active one.

Services.Name: GameItems
Services.Description: The rules of moving the items of a game: what lies where after an item is moved onto a place.

Services.Name: Achievements
Services.Description: The achievements of an Application (a game, a course, a profile...), shown one after another by an AchievementHost (place one in the layout of the Application, as a ToastHost).

Services.Name: Diff
Services.Description: The differences between two texts (the algorithm of Myers: the shortest list of changes).

Services.Name: Push
Services.Description: Web Push: the server of the Application sends messages that reach the user even while the page is closed (a Service Worker shows them as notifications).

Services.Name: Serial
Services.Description: Serial ports (COM ports, UART: Arduino, GPS, scales, printers...) through Web Serial: Chrome and Edge on the desktop, HTTPS or localhost.

Services.Name: USB
Services.Description: USB devices through WebUSB (Chrome and Edge; HTTPS or localhost): devices with a driver of their own, not the ones the system keeps (keyboards, disks).

Services.Name: NFC
Services.Description: NFC tags through Web NFC: Chrome on Android, HTTPS.

Services.Name: Countries
Services.Description: Countries and territories with their dialling code, the mask of the national number (# is a digit) and currency.

Services.Name: Currencies
Services.Description: The active ISO 4217 currencies.

Services.Name: Toast
Services.Description: Notifications shown by a ToastHost (place one in the layout of the Application).

Services.Name: Dialogs
Services.Description: Confirmations and alerts from the code, shown by a DialogHost (place one in the layout of the Application): a modal Dialog without one of its own in a template.

Services.Name: Reveal
Services.Description: Showing what a field hides: a password (Input), a card number (CardNumberInput), a security code (CVVInput) or a one-time code (OTPInput).

Services.Name: Hotkeys
Services.Description: Keyboard shortcuts of the page.

Services.Name: Biometric
Services.Description: The fingerprint, face or PIN of the device (Touch ID, Windows Hello, Android) through WebAuthn: HTTPS or localhost.

Services.Name: Clipboard
Services.Description: The clipboard.

Services.Name: Idle
Services.Description: The inactivity of the user, as a banking application that signs out after some minutes.

Services.Name: PictureInPicture
Services.Description: Picture-in-Picture: a video, or any part of the page, in a small window of its own that stays over the other windows of the system.

Services.Name: Permissions
Services.Description: The permissions of the browser.

Services.Name: Native
Services.Description: The native features of the system around the Application, one API wherever it runs.

Services.Name: Cities
Services.Description: The cities of the world from GeoNames (every city of a thousand people or more, CC BY 4.0: show Attribution where the cities are seen): their names, countries, regions, coordinates and time zones.

Services.Name: Badges
Services.Description: The badges of *badge and of the Badge of a Button.

Services.Name: Forms
Services.Description: The models of forms: the values a form collects and their validation, as the forms of Angular have them.

Services.Name: Menus
Services.Description: The items of a menu declared in a template with MenuItem (Menu and ContextMenu use it).

Services.Name: Panels
Services.Description: The panels a component declares in its template, as the tabs of a Tabs (Tab) and of a Ribbon (RibbonTab): a child component renders an element of a class (its panel) whose data-* attributes describe it, and the owner reads them.

Services.Name: Find
Services.Description: Finds text in the DOM: what the find bar of a RichEditor or a Terminal looks through.

Services.Name: Formulas
Services.Description: Formulas written as in LaTeX, drawn by the browser as MathML.

Services.Name: Designer
Services.Description: The document of a designer of pages: its nodes, their props and layout, the selection, the history and the template.

Services.Name: Random
Services.Description: Random numbers of a seed: always the same numbers for the same seed.

Services.Name: Spatial
Services.Description: Where things are on a plane, found fast: a grid of buckets for the queries of a rectangle, a radius and the nearest.

Services.Name: Pathfinding
Services.Description: The ways across a map: A*, Dijkstra and flow fields on a grid, A* on a graph of your own.

Services.Name: Visibility
Services.Description: What can be seen on a grid: lines, the line of sight, the field of view and the fog of war.

Services.Name: GameLoop
Services.Description: The loop of a game: updates in steps of the same time, drawn once a frame.

Services.Name: GameMaps
Services.Description: The maps of GameWorld: its own JSON, or a map of Tiled (.tmj), made into one form.

Services.Name: Suprematist
Services.Description: Pictures in the manner of Suprematism, made of a seed: always the same for the same seed.

Directives.Name: popup
Directives.Description: *popup="Open" shows the element as a floating panel next to its anchor while the expression is truthy.

Directives.Name: mask
Directives.Description: *mask="{Mask: Mask, Value: Value}" keeps an <input> strictly inside a mask.

Directives.Name: resizable
Directives.Description: *resizable="'right bottom'" adds resize handles to the element: right, left, bottom, top and corner (bottom right).

Directives.Name: modal
Directives.Description: *modal="Open" opens a <dialog> element as a modal while the expression is truthy and closes it otherwise.

Directives.Name: draggable
Directives.Description: *draggable="{Data: item, Type: 'task', Handle: '.grip'}" (or just *draggable="item") lets the element be dragged with the pointer onto *droppable elements that accept Type.

Directives.Name: droppable
Directives.Description: *droppable="{Accept: ['task'], Files: true, Text: true}" makes the element a drop target.

Directives.Name: mount
Directives.Description: *mount="source" places custom content in the element: source is a DOM node (moved in), a function (called once with the element) or an object with Element or Render(container, item).

Directives.Name: glyph
Directives.Description: *glyph="reference" draws a sprite symbol inside an <svg>.

Directives.Name: hotkey
Directives.Description: *hotkey="'Mod+S'" (or *hotkey="{Keys: 'Mod+S', Scope: 'local', Description: 'Save', Group: 'File'}") clicks the element when the keys are pressed, unless it is disabled or hidden, and sets its aria-keyshortcuts.

Directives.Name: copy
Directives.Description: *copy="text" copies text when the element is clicked (or *copy="{Text, Toast}": Toast true or a message shows a toast).

Directives.Name: itemcard
Directives.Description: *itemcard="item" shows the card of an item of a game on any element: under the pointer or the focus, beside the element (GameItems.Place), as GameInventory and GameSlot show it.

Directives.Name: badge
Directives.Description: *badge="value" puts a badge over the corner of any element: an item of a toolbar, of a list, a picture.

Directives.Name: swipe
Directives.Description: *swipe makes an element follow a finger (a pen, or a mouse with Mouse) along an axis and tells the end of the move: *swipe, *swipe="'y'" or *swipe="{Axis: 'x' or 'y', Threshold: 40, Mouse: false}".

Directives.Name: tip
Directives.Description: *tip shows a tip of the theme over an element, as the ScreenTips of Microsoft Office: a bold Title with Text under it, or any content.
